description.value: Sarhad Dhaba is an Indian and pizza restaurant in Penticton serving a wide range of South Asian dishes — from Chana Bhatura and Goat Biryani to tandoori meats and vegetarian curries — alongside a pizza menu, all available for dine-in or takeout. The kitchen blends traditional techniques with a broad menu spanning snacks, mains, rice dishes, and sweets, making it a solid stop for a substantial hot meal mid-tour. Catering for large events is also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active restaurant offering both dine-in and takeout, with the phrase 'dine-in or take-out' and the legal name 'Sarhad Dhab Take Out & Catering Ltd.' The menu is extensive and clearly divided into vegetarian and non-vegetarian sections, confirming vegetarian options. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Sarhad Dhaba Indian and Pizza' but the website legal name is 'Sarhad Dhab Take Out & Catering Ltd.' — possible truncation or alternate trading name; worth verifying.
No address or phone number available in OSM tags or website content provided.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant in Penticton with a live website, full menu, and confirmed takeout service — straightforward inclusion for the directory.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu has a dedicated vegetarian section with numerous options including Dal Tadka, Chana Masala, Palak Paneer, Malai Kofta, and many others. No GF or vegan confirmation
